Rules.InvariantScript:
// Get Current Date (no Time)
Set(CurrentDate, Today()); 

Set(
    MinStartDate,
    If(
        Switch(
            Weekday(CurrentDate, StartOfWeek.Monday),
            1, DateAdd(CurrentDate, 2),
            2, DateAdd(CurrentDate, 2),
            3, DateAdd(CurrentDate, 2),
            4, DateAdd(CurrentDate, 2),
            5, If(TimeValue(Text(Now(), "hh:mm:ss")) < TimeValue("17:00:00"), DateAdd(CurrentDate, 2), DateAdd(CurrentDate, 4)),
            6, DateAdd(CurrentDate, 3),
            7, DateAdd(CurrentDate, 2)
        ) <= DateValue("2025-06-03"),
        DateValue("2025-06-04"),
        Switch(
            Weekday(CurrentDate, StartOfWeek.Monday),
            1, DateAdd(CurrentDate, 2),
            2, DateAdd(CurrentDate, 2),
            3, DateAdd(CurrentDate, 2),
            4, DateAdd(CurrentDate, 2),
            5, If(TimeValue(Text(Now(), "hh:mm:ss")) < TimeValue("17:00:00"), DateAdd(CurrentDate, 2), DateAdd(CurrentDate, 4)),
            6, DateAdd(CurrentDate, 3),
            7, DateAdd(CurrentDate, 2)
        )
    )
);
